description:
Create a standardized document folder structure for a specific complaint case. 

1. Find the complaint case titled 'Records Management Folder Setup - 2024-RM-0047' (it has been pre-created for you).
2. Navigate to the 'Documents' tab of this case.
3. Create exactly four new folders at the root level of the case's document tree:
   - Evidence
   - Correspondence
   - Legal_Briefs
   - Witness_Statements

Ensure the folder names match exactly (case-sensitive).
